_comment: One row per copy key: English intent + draft Swahili. Generated Swahili is UNREVIEWED until a native reviewer signs it in review/swahili-review-sheet.csv. {placeholders} are filled by code; numbers in Swahili audio are rendered as words by code.
screen.today.title: Today
Leo
screen.evidence.title: What visitors said
Walichosema wageni
screen.outbox.title: Waiting to send
Ujumbe unaosubiri
screen.offline: No signal. Everything still works; messages wait until signal returns.
Hakuna mtandao. Kila kitu kinafanya kazi; ujumbe utasubiri mtandao urudi.
screen.empty: Bado hakuna maoni ya wageni yaliyohifadhiwa.
screen.working: Reading the feedback on this phone...
screen.clock_suspect: The phone clock looks wrong. Nothing can be approved, stopped or sent until it is fixed.
Saa ya simu inaonekana si sahihi. Hakuna kinachoweza kuidhinishwa, kusitishwa au kutumwa hadi irekebishwe.
card.mentions: {count} comments mention this (a review copied word for word to two sites counts once)
Maoni {count} yanataja hili (maoni yaliyonakiliwa neno kwa neno kwenye tovuti mbili yanahesabiwa mara moja)
finding.uncertain: Not sure. Ask a person before deciding.
Sina uhakika. Muulize mtu kabla ya kuamua.
finding.not_enough: Not enough feedback to conclude (fewer than three comments).
Maoni hayatoshi kufikia uamuzi (chini ya maoni matatu).
finding.missing_fact: This is not in your farm sheet. I will not guess it.
Hili halipo kwenye taarifa za shamba lako. Sitakisia.
preview.waits_for_signal: It waits for signal before sending.
preview.unreviewed: Not yet checked by a Swahili speaker.
preview.simulated: TEST ONLY. Will not reach a real person.
approval.confirm: Noor, send exactly this message? Enter your Sauti PIN to approve. You can still stop it before it leaves the phone.
Noor, utume ujumbe huu kama ulivyo? Weka PIN yako ya Sauti kuidhinisha. Bado unaweza kuusitisha kabla haujatoka kwenye simu.
approval.owner_unlock: Approval is turned off on this phone. Only Noor's phone can approve.
Kuidhinisha kumezimwa kwenye simu hii. Simu ya Noor pekee inaweza kuidhinisha.
approval.stale: This card changed. Please look at it again before deciding.
Kadi hii imebadilika. Tafadhali iangalie tena kabla ya kuamua.
state.business.expired: Too late, it will not be sent
state.business.cancelled: Your farm details changed. See the new suggestion.
Taarifa za shamba zimebadilika. Angalia pendekezo jipya.
state.transport.queued: Waiting for signal, not sent yet
state.transport.send_unknown: Not sure if it was sent
state.transport.send_unknown.note: Do not send it again. Ask the visitor or a person who can check.
Usiutume tena. Muulize mgeni au mtu anayeweza kuangalia.
state.special.cancel_after_acceptance: Already sent. It cannot be called back.
template.ask_which_direction_step: Thank you for visiting us. Which part of the directions was hard?
Asante kwa kututembelea. Ni sehemu gani ya maelekezo iliyokuwa ngumu?
template.thanks_polite_disagree: Thank you for your feedback. We are sorry it was not as you hoped.
Asante kwa maoni yako. Samahani kwamba haikuwa kama ulivyotarajia.
template.thanks_positive: Thank you for your kind words. You are welcome back any time.
Asante kwa maneno yako mazuri. Karibu tena wakati wowote.
w2.confidence_low: I am not sure I understood.
w2.reply_meaning: What the reply says, in Swahili
w2.no_draft: I will not draft a reply. Here is the message; tell me what to answer.
Sitaandika jibu. Huu ndio ujumbe; niambie nijibu nini.
a11y.hint.approve: Shows the message one more time and asks for your Sauti PIN.
Itaonyesha ujumbe mara moja zaidi na kuomba PIN yako ya Sauti.
a11y.hint.ask_someone: Keeps this card open so you can ask a person first.
Kadi hii itabaki wazi ili umuulize mtu kwanza.
a11y.hint.view_evidence: Shows the exact words visitors wrote.
a11y.hint.revoke: Asks for your Sauti PIN. Stops the message if it has not left the phone yet.
Itaomba PIN yako ya Sauti. Inasitisha ujumbe kama bado haujatoka kwenye simu.
finding.model_label_unverified: Suggested by the phone's AI, not checked. Read the quotes before deciding.
Imependekezwa na AI ya simu, haijathibitishwa. Soma maneno yao kabla ya kuamua.
action.revoke.may_be_sent: It may already have left. Stopping prevents new attempts but cannot call it back.
Huenda umeshatoka. Kusitisha kunazuia majaribio mapya lakini hakuwezi kuurudisha.
state.business.revoked.note: If the network confirms it was sent before you stopped it, that will show here.
Mtandao ukithibitisha kuwa ulitumwa kabla hujasitisha, itaonyeshwa hapa.
screen.farm.title: My farm
Shamba langu
farm.capacity: Idadi ya juu ya wageni kwa ziara
farm.save_confirm: Save these farm details? Replies will use them.
Uhifadhi taarifa hizi za shamba? Majibu yatazitumia.
farm.revision: Toleo la {revision} la taarifa za shamba lako
farm.changed_voids: Your farm details changed. Suggestions made before will be prepared again.
Taarifa za shamba zimebadilika. Mapendekezo ya awali yataandaliwa upya.
screen.visits.title: Visits
Ziara
visits.fits: There is room on this day.
visits.closed_day: You do not receive visitors on this day.
visits.outside_hours: This time is outside your tour hours.
Saa hii iko nje ya saa za ziara.
visits.date_unclear: The date is not clear. I will not guess it.
visits.reminder: Reminder the day before (you approve it first)
a11y.hint.arrived: Records that the visitors came. Nothing is sent.
Inarekodi kuwa wageni wamefika. Hakuna kinachotumwa.
a11y.hint.no_show: Records that the visitors did not come. Nothing is sent.
Inarekodi kuwa wageni hawakuja. Hakuna kinachotumwa.
approval.pin_prompt: Your Sauti PIN (not the phone's code)
PIN yako ya Sauti (si nambari ya simu)
approval.pin_locked: Too many wrong tries. Try again in fifteen minutes.
Umejaribu mara nyingi sana. Jaribu tena baada ya dakika kumi na tano.
approval.pin_forgotten: Forgot your PIN? You can set a new one in My farm. Waiting approvals will be cancelled.
Umesahau PIN? Unaweza kuweka mpya kwenye Shamba langu. Idhini zinazosubiri zitafutwa.
approval.pin_setup: Choose a four-digit Sauti PIN. Only you should know it, not the person who owns the phone.
Chagua PIN ya Sauti ya tarakimu nne. Wewe pekee ndiye unapaswa kuijua, si mwenye simu.
a11y.hint.open_messages: Opens the phone's Messages with the approved text. You press Send.
Inafungua Messages za simu na ujumbe ulioidhinishwa. Wewe unabonyeza Tuma.
state.transport.sent_sms: Handed to Messages. There is no delivery receipt.
Umekabidhiwa kwa Messages. Hakuna uthibitisho wa kufika.
state.transport.composer_cancelled: Not sent: Messages was closed without sending. You can open it again.
Haujatumwa: Messages ilifungwa bila kutuma. Unaweza kuifungua tena.
voice.not_understood: I did not understand. Nothing was changed.
free_text.ask_guide: Ask the guide or your daughter to read it
Muulize mwongozo au binti yako ausome
free_text.machine_translation: Tafsiri ya mashine, inaweza kuwa na makosa
